component.name: Luma
component.summary: Free open-source terminal and SSH client

description.p: Luma combines local and serial terminals, saved SSH connections, SFTP, port forwarding, snippets, and optional end-to-end encrypted configuration sync in one modern application.

This independently distributed Flatpak uses broad host filesystem and device access because Luma manages local files, SSH keys, and serial devices. Local terminal sessions run inside the Flatpak environment.
